messages:
Ravi Shah: Heads up 9 I had to fly to the consulate overnight for an emergency visa appointment. Paid an expedited visa fee, a courier fee to overnight my passport back, and a last-minute hotel for the night. What is reimbursable here?
people-ops-bot: Travel policy snippet -> visa/immigration fees are generally reimbursable if required for a company business trip and pre-approved. Courier fees for essential document return may be reimbursable with receipts. Emergency travel exceptions require manager approval. See: https://intranet/redwood/te/visas (auto-note)
Clara Gomez: TL;DR: If the visa was required specifically for a customer meeting or required by the company, we cover visa fee + courier + reasonable lodging for the appointment night. You need manager sign-off and receipts.
Ravi Shah: It was required for an in-person customer workshop; I notified my manager after I booked (same day). I have the consulate receipt ($210 USD), courier receipt (EUR 24), and hotel folio ($132). Currency exchange on my card shows the EUR -> USD conversion.
Finance Bot: Audit tips for mixed-currency claims:
- Submit original foreign currency receipts (photo/scan) plus the card statement showing the FX charge.
- For small courier amounts <$50, we accept the receipt screenshot.
- Tag expenses as: Visa Fee, Document Courier, Lodging (Visa Appointment).
Aisha Khan: Practical process: get retroactive manager approval in Slack/email (screenshot) and attach when you submit. In Concur use expense types below and include the consulate appointment confirmation if available.
```
Expense type mapping:
- Visa Fee -> TRV-VISA-2026
- Document Courier -> TRV-COURIER-2026
- Lodging (Visa) -> TRV-LODG-VISA
Required attachments: consulate appointment confirmation, original receipts, card statement showing charge, manager approval screenshot
Notes: mark business purpose = "Customer workshop requirement - visa appointment"
```
Ravi Shah: Good to know. What about a service charge the consulate added for card use (7%)? Is that reimbursed?
Clara Gomez: Yes, consulate surcharges and processing agency fees are reimbursable if they are mandatory for the visa issuance. If optional service add-ons (like premium photo) list them and we'll review.
Finance Bot: If the consulate refunds any portion later, notify travel@redwood.com so finance can reconcile.
Ravi Shah: One more 9 the courier gave me a tracking invoice that lists VAT; do we need VAT back-up?
Aisha Khan: Include the full courier invoice showing VAT. Finance will process gross amounts; reclaiming VAT depends on country rules and is handled centrally if material. For small amounts we don't pursue VAT recovery.
Ravi Shah: I'll submit now with manager approval screenshot. Thanks! :thumbsup:
